activity_summary: You came out of St Helen's with the household into a hot morning. Master Thwaite had kept to three heads. A man at the porch asked Gillis his birth, and was told Norwich. Sir John left by his own door and said nothing. No order has shut the playhouse. You are to meet the fellows in the morning. Mistress Ansell wanted the front windows shut, and the weather left outside.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Greeted the porch, left Friday where it was, and named no order that shuts the house.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Stopped the questions, set the walking order, and wanted the weather kept outside.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Counted three heads, noted Sir John's silence, and asked what tomorrow is.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Answered Norwich to a man at the porch, and kept the loom for the back room.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Brought the dust in on a heel, and reported the cat.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Passed to his own door and did not speak.

facets.activity: Came out of St Helen's and heard Norwich at the porch

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: The heads were three, and three is enough when men are already counting doors

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: We meet in the morning and see what the morning is

quotes.speaker: gillis_verbeke
quotes.text: Norwich, sir. I have always had a Norwich face, and a loom in Bishopsgate
